source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Use annual cervical cytology after sexual activity begins because frequent testing is the safest approach for average-risk adults.","B":"Stop screening after one normal adult test when there is no history of cervical disease or immunocompromise.","C":"Base screening on age, test strategy, prior screening history, and risk factors, with individualized follow-up when risk is higher.","D":"Select the interval mainly from patient preference because current recommendations do not distinguish among age groups and test strategies."}}
source_row.rationale: The current USPSTF cervical-cancer screening recommendation uses age and screening-test strategy to determine routine intervals and identifies higher-risk situations that require individualized follow-up; prior screening history also affects decisions such as when screening can stop. Option C best reflects that framework. Option A incorrectly applies annual screening to everyone. Option B stops after one normal result without regard to recommended intervals or history. Option D ignores guideline-based age, test, and risk criteria.
source_row.source_detail: USPSTF Cervical Cancer: Screening — current final recommendation framework uses age, test strategy, prior adequate screening and risk status; higher-risk patients require individualized follow-up. USPSTF 2018 Final Recommendation remains the current final recommendation on 2026-08-15; 2024-12-10 draft update remains in-progress and does not supersede the final recommendation. NCSBN first-check: Client Needs — Health Promotion and Maintenance; preventive care, screening, prenatal/postpartum and newborn health-promotion activities as applicable. 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan; effective 2026-04-01 through 2029-03-31; currentness rechecked 2026-08-15.
source_row.source_name: U.S. Preventive Services Task Force — Cervical Cancer: Screening
source_row.stem: A nurse is discussing cervical cancer screening with an average-risk adult. Which statement best reflects how the screening plan should be determined?
